The simplest fix is to not use ElementTree's serializer at all for the text content. Instead, I'll build the string directly by:
1. Processing the text content (replacing stash placeholders with raw HTML)
2. Serializing each child element using md.serializer()
3. Processing tail text similarly

This way, the raw HTML tags in text content won't be escaped because we're building a string directly rather than going through ElementTree serialization.
